name: Queensland 50 cent fares
summary: Every fare is 50 cents a journey, so there is no student concession to apply for.
key: 50 cents a journey, however far you go and however you pay.
who: Everyone. Tertiary students no longer need to apply for concession fares.
catches: The official page does not say how long the flat fare lasts, so we check it every two weeks.
School leavers can keep using a green concession go card and may need to update its expiry date.
